versions.changelog: Public-safe rewrite: class-based routing, no pinned old model IDs, image/video to a dedicated model, Gemini for long context only.

- Added a "Fallback Rule" section clarifying what to do if a preferred model is unavailable.
- Explained that the doctrine describes intent and recommends using the best available model rather than failing.
- No changes to routing logic or decision flow; update is guidance-focused.

- Initial release of fleet-doctrine skill, defining model routing strategy for multi-model AI fleets.
- Clearly outlines roles, routing rules, and decision flow for Opus, Codex, Sonnet, Gemini, and Grok models.
- Includes anti-patterns to avoid common routing mistakes.
- Provides usage guidelines, default aliases, and best practices for spawning and delegating sub-agents.
